data.title: KPMG Venture Pulse, Q4 2021
data.summary: Global venture capital investment totalled $671 billion across 2021, the highest annual figure in the series, of which $171.4 billion was invested in Q4 2021 across 8,710 deals. Underlying data provided by PitchBook as of 31 December 2021.
data.citation: KPMG Private Enterprise, Venture Pulse Q4 2021: Global analysis of venture funding, 19 January 2022, p. 7.
